content.short: Sarcophagus is a blockchain-enabled digital dead man's switch to pass data in a censorship-resistant manner.
content.description: Sarcophagus is a blockchain-enabled digital dead man’s switch that automatically releases data when predefined conditions are met. It is autonomous, censorship-resistant, and immutable, leveraging networks such as Ethereum and Arweave’s permanent file storage to hold the contents you place in a sarcophagus. Files are unlocked only if you fail to attest to the contract. Use cases include will and trust, password recovery, credential passdown, political activism or whistleblowing, password or key material backup, and emergency communications. It supports Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Base, Arbitrum, and BNB Chain.
